benzoic acid, thymol or their combinations could improve growth performance and gut microfloral balance, and the combination of 2 g/kg benzoic and 0.1 g/kg thymol was more effective than others.
the combination of benzoic and thymol can improve gut health and growth performance in weaned pigs.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
benzoic acid/thymol supplementation could improve the growth performance and gut health in piglets.
the combination of 2 g/kg benzoic and 100 mg/kg thylmol in weaned pig diets could improve growth performance and gut health.
the combination of 2g/kg benzoic and 100 mg/kg thyme could be a good strategy to enhance the gut health in pigs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
dietary supplementation with benzoic acid (up to 2,000mg/kg) and thymol (up to 100mg/kg) can be a potential strategy to improve gut characteristics and growth performance of weaned pigs.
benzoic acid combined with thymol can improve growth performance and gut health in weaned pigs.
the combination of 2 g/kg benzoic and 100 mg/kg thyme oil is a promising alternative to improve growth performance and reduce diarrhoea in weaned pigs.
